Source assets for Toon Tale's pets (PetData): three CC0 KayKit characters by Kay Lousberg
and the shared KayKit character animation clips, all from
https://github.com/series-ai/jam-ready-assets at commit ab1b21fe61bc3adeb759c286e770033563f18a97.

  fire   คาอิจูเร็กซ์  Monster.glb (Mystery Monthly S4, Monster Costume) + a flame skin
  water  โกเลมน้ำแข็ง  FrostGolem.glb (Mystery Monthly S5)
  earth  ดรูอิดป่า     Druid.glb (KayKit Adventurers)

SOURCE.json lists every original file with its pinned URL, size and SHA-256, the runtime
files made from them (assets/models/pets/) with their hashes, and how they were made
(tools/bake_pets.gd, tools/pet_skin_retex.py). The LICENSE-*.txt files are the license
texts that sit next to each pack in that commit (all CC0-1.0).
